meta.notes: Level-30 WoW Forever beta BiS scraped from foreverchanges.pro (site warns: early list, beta is days old, rankings may change). Item IDs taken from the site item links (/item/<id>); random-suffix items ("of the Tiger" etc.) use the base item ID. IDs >= ~249000 are new WoW Forever items not present on Classic Era wowhead; lower IDs are Classic Era items. Entries with a "faction" field are Alliance- or Horde-only. Lists include extra entries (up to 6) when faction-only items would otherwise leave a faction with fewer than 3 options. Two-handers are in mainhand with offhand empty. For Paladin/Shaman/Druid the ranged slot holds the relic list. Hunter and Warlock have one PvE list reused across specs; Priest Discipline reuses Holy PvE. Random-suffix entries keep the suffixed display name (e.g. "Unearthed Bands of the Tiger") but the id is the base item, so GetItemInfo returns the unsuffixed name. IDs spot-checked against foreverdb.net and wowhead.com/forever (9/9 names matched); wowhead.com/classic does not know the new >=249000 IDs.
